generated_from: the format's reference implementation (not this repository)
caveat: Expected values come from the reference implementation, so they pin its behaviour rather than proving the spec. A mismatch means 'these two implementations differ -- read the cited SPEC section', not 'you are wrong'.
how_to_use: accept: decode the .nvaa file and compare your result with the .expected.json. reject: decoding the animation MUST fail -- any error is fine, silently producing an animation is not. Note that the payload-defect vectors are only detectable once frames are parsed, so a metadata-only reader may not encounter them.

vectors.name: minimal
vectors.intent: Smallest valid container: 1x1 canvas, one frame, no index, no CRC (SPEC.md 4, 5, 8).

vectors.name: body-span
vectors.intent: One long same-style run in one row: the span body (SPEC.md 9.1) must be the smallest and is therefore used.

vectors.name: body-gap
vectors.intent: Two far-apart cells: the position-delta body (SPEC.md 9.3) must win. This is the grammar that carries real video content.

vectors.name: body-list
vectors.intent: A single cell: the cell-list body (SPEC.md 9.2) must win. Both grammar flags clear means cell-list, so a decoder cannot skip it.

vectors.name: keyframe-and-delta
vectors.intent: A keyframe then a delta, with the camera moving and the viewport declared (SPEC.md 8.3, 8.5).

vectors.name: deflate-index-crc
vectors.intent: PAYLOAD_DEFLATED plus INDEX_BLOCK and CRC_BLOCK (SPEC.md 10, 11.1, 11.2). Payloads must be inflated before parsing; the index holds u32 absolute frame offsets; the CRC covers every byte before its marker.

vectors.name: empty-style-clears
vectors.intent: A delta writes the empty style (style 0) over a painted cell. The expanded canvas must NOT contain that cell afterwards (SPEC.md 7, 13).

vectors.name: wide-glyph
vectors.intent: An East-Asian wide glyph occupies two columns and BOTH columns carry the same style (SPEC.md 7). A renderer emits the glyph once and skips the second column.

vectors.name: metadata-all-types
vectors.intent: All six value types (SPEC.md 6.4): null, uint, int, bool, text, blob. Keys are stored in strict byte order regardless of insertion order.

vectors.name: no-camera-mode
vectors.intent: HAS_CAMERA clear (SPEC.md 5.1): no frame carries a camera field and the viewport defaults to the canvas size.

vectors.name: reject-bad-signature
vectors.intent: The 9-byte signature is mandatory (SPEC.md 3.1).

vectors.name: reject-bad-brand
vectors.intent: The in-header brand must read NVAA (SPEC.md 3.2), so a payload extracted from a wrapper can still identify itself.

vectors.name: reject-unknown-version
vectors.intent: VERSION is a dispatch key, not a negotiation (SPEC.md 5).

vectors.name: reject-reserved-header-flag
vectors.intent: Reserved header flag bits MUST be 0 (SPEC.md 5.1): a decoder may not assume it understands a field it cannot see.

vectors.name: reject-reserved-frame-flag
vectors.intent: Reserved frame flag bits MUST be 0 (SPEC.md 8.2).

vectors.name: reject-both-body-flags
vectors.intent: PAYLOAD_SPAN and PAYLOAD_GAP MUST NOT both be set (SPEC.md 8.2): the payload would be readable two ways.

vectors.name: reject-first-frame-not-keyframe
vectors.intent: The first frame MUST be a keyframe (SPEC.md 8.5): a delta has no predecessor to apply against.

vectors.name: reject-truncated
vectors.intent: A truncated stream MUST be rejected rather than half-decoded; STREAM_END (SPEC.md 11.3) exists so this is detectable.

vectors.name: reject-trailing-garbage
vectors.defect: four bytes appended after the end of the stream
vectors.intent: No bytes may follow the final block (SPEC.md 12): trailing data means a corrupt file or a mis-parse.

vectors.name: reject-duplicate-coordinate
vectors.defect: the second payload entry given the same (x, y) as the first
vectors.intent: A frame MUST NOT assign one coordinate twice (SPEC.md 9.4); otherwise the result depends on write order.

vectors.name: reject-style-out-of-range
vectors.defect: the second payload entry given style_id == style_count
vectors.intent: A style_id outside the style table MUST be rejected (SPEC.md 9.1).

vectors.name: reject-crc-mismatch
vectors.defect: one payload byte flipped; the CRC block at offset 78 untouched
vectors.intent: CRC_BLOCK covers every byte before its marker (SPEC.md 11.2). Flipping a payload byte while leaving the CRC block intact must be caught.

vectors.name: reject-bad-index-offset
vectors.defect: the first index entry incremented by one
vectors.intent: INDEX_BLOCK entries must be the absolute offsets of the frame units (SPEC.md 11.1). A wrong offset destroys the only reason the index exists, which is seeking.

vectors.name: reject-unknown-metadata-type
vectors.intent: Unknown metadata keys MUST be ignored, but an unknown value_type MUST be an error (SPEC.md 6.4): a decoder cannot safely skip a payload whose encoding it does not know.

vectors.name: reject-metadata-keys-unsorted
vectors.defect: the two items swapped, so keys descend
vectors.intent: Metadata keys MUST be unique and in strict byte order (SPEC.md 6.4), so that encoding is deterministic and two files can be diffed.
